info.title: TalentTrust API
info.description:
Milestone-based escrow API for freelancers and clients. State mirrors the TalentTrust Soroban escrow contract on Stellar testnet (CCZMIVUBMG5SBC47SDTC32RWLBJ2HW2DCFVWJEOKCH2IFJBZGBKTXK5W). Explorer: https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet/contract/CCZMIVUBMG5SBC47SDTC32RWLBJ2HW2DCFVWJEOKCH2IFJBZGBKTXK5W. Data is held in memory and resets on redeploy.

**Response compression**: The API compresses JSON responses ≥ 1 KB with gzip or Brotli when the client sends an `Accept-Encoding` header. A `Vary: Accept-Encoding` header is included on compressed responses.

**Sparse fieldsets**: GET /contracts and GET /contracts/:id accept a `?fields=` query parameter so clients can download only the fields they need.

**Authentication**: mutating routes accept a bearer token obtained via the auth endpoints. Call `GET /api/v1/auth/challenge?address=G…`, sign the returned challenge string with your Stellar ed25519 private key, then `POST /api/v1/auth/token` to receive a short-lived JWT. Tokens are required when the server runs with `AUTH_SECRET` set (or `AUTH_REQUIRED=true`).

post.summary: Manually redeliver a finished webhook delivery
post.description: Re-sends the original payload of a `success` or `failed` delivery as a new delivery: same `eventId` (and `X-Event-ID` header), fresh `X-Delivery-ID`, new signature and timestamp, and the normal retry policy. The new delivery records the original in `redeliveryOf`. Payloads are kept only for deliveries still in the bounded history and are never returned by the history endpoint.

get.summary: List the admin dispute queue

The summary always covers ALL disputes in the store (open = contracts currently Disputed, overdue = open disputes past their SLA deadline, totalHeld = escrow held across open disputes), regardless of the filters. Dispute reasons are only exposed here and on /api/v1/disputes/{contractId}.

Health check
Liveness probe
get.description: Always 200 while the process is up; touches no dependency.

get.summary: Readiness probe
get.description: Checks the Soroban RPC health, the network passphrase, the escrow contract ledger entry and the store in parallel. Results are cached for HEALTH_CACHE_MS with single-flight. 200 when every check passes (or only warns), 503 when a critical check fails. Failure details never include the RPC URL.

get.summary: Published ed25519 public keys for offline JWS receipt verification
On-chain escrow contract deployment info with live contract status
get.description: Static deployment info, the pause guard state, and `onChain`, a cached snapshot read from the Soroban RPC (contract version, paused flag, escrow count, admin, latest ledger). The endpoint always returns 200; when the RPC is unreachable, `onChain.reachable` is false and `onChain.error` explains why. If a previous snapshot exists it is served with `onChain.stale` true. Results are cached for CHAIN_STATUS_TTL_MS (15s); `refresh=true` bypasses the cache at most once per CHAIN_REFRESH_MIN_INTERVAL_MS (5s).

post.summary: Build a simulated, unsigned Soroban transaction for an escrow action
post.description: Assembles an unsigned invokeHostFunction transaction against the configured escrow contract, simulates it via Soroban RPC, and returns the assembled XDR ready for a wallet (Freighter, xBull, …) to sign. The server never holds or requires user secret keys. `source` must be the Stellar account that the contract will `require_auth` (client for create/deposit/release/cancel/issue_reputation, caller for open_dispute). `resolve_dispute` and `set_paused` are admin-only and not buildable.

Pass `page.nextCursor` back as `cursor` (with the same `sort`) for the next page; ties are broken by id. Use `?fields=` to request a sparse response — only the listed fields are included, reducing payload size for list views.

get.summary: Ranked freelancer leaderboard (Bayesian score)
get.description: score = round2((C * m + totalRating) / (C + completedContracts)) with m the global mean rating (3 when there are none) and C = REPUTATION_PRIOR_WEIGHT (default 5). Ties break by completedContracts desc, then address. Optionally filter to a recent time window with since or windowDays (mutually exclusive) using a window-specific global mean.

bearerAuth.description: HS256 JWT obtained via POST /api/v1/auth/token after signing a challenge.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 1-255 printable ASCII characters. Retrying a POST, PATCH, PUT or DELETE with the same key and body replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` instead of applying it twice (empty DELETE bodies fingerprint as `{}`). Responses with status >= 500 are not stored. Keys are kept for 24h and scoped by method, path and authenticated principal (if any). Required on POST when the server runs with IDEMPOTENCY_REQUIRED=true.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The path exists but does not support this HTTP method (`method_not_allowed`).

Allow.description: Comma-separated list of supported methods, including HEAD for GET routes.

NotFound.description: No route matches the method and path (`not_found`, with `docs`)

InvalidIdempotencyKey.description: Idempotency-Key is malformed (`invalid_idempotency_key`) or missing while required (`idempotency_key_required`)

IdempotencyConflict.description: `idempotency_request_in_progress`: a request with this key is still running (see `Retry-After`). Other 409 codes are business-rule conflicts such as `over_funded`.

IdempotencyKeyReused.description: `idempotency_key_reused`: the key was already used with a different request body
